حَذَذٌ , an inf. n. having no verb, (Az, L,) Lightness of the tail: (S, L, K:) lightness of the hair of the tail of a horse: shortness of the tail of an ass; and of a bird of the kind called قَطًا; or lightness of the feathers of the tail thereof; or (assumed tropical:) lightness and quickness of the flight thereof: (L:) and lightness of the beard. (L.) ―
-b2- (assumed tropical:) Lightness of hand. (S. [See أَحَذُّ.]) (assumed tropical:) Quickness: or quickness and lightness or agility. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
